payload.body: The source assigns x(n)=nL for integer n>=0 and a length scale L, but assigns no t(n). A proposed uniform interval tau>0 would give the conditional step ratio L/tau. Different positive time intervals yield different speeds while preserving every source position; no speed c is identified by the packet. Treat any time rule as a proposed assumption.
limitations: Algebra and dimensional reasoning only; no assigned physical clock or validated physical propagation speed.
payload.requested_response: At the released peer phase, distinguish an assigned clock rule from a proposed clock rule against this exact source; stop after one evidence reply.
